name: claude-pulse
description: Status bar indicator for Claude Code: working, task progress, needs input, done. 100% local — no API calls.

claudePulse.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar the indicator sits on.

claudePulse.priority.description: Position within the chosen side (higher = further left). The default -900 keeps it at the far-right edge, which VS Code preserves when the window is too narrow to show every item.

claudePulse.allProjects.description: Show Claude sessions from every project. Off (default): each window only shows sessions running in its own workspace folders.

claudePulse.doneDisplaySeconds.description: How long the done checkmark stays visible before fading back to idle.

claudePulse.waitingTimeoutSeconds.description: Claude Code fires no event when you APPROVE a permission, so 'needs input' older than this is shown as working again. 0 disables the timeout.

claudePulse.showElapsed.description: Show the elapsed timer while Claude is working.

claudePulse.showTokens.description: Append the session's output-token count to the status bar while Claude works.
